technical.rendering: All marketing and article pages statically generated; content, title, canonical and links in server HTML. Check rendered HTML with URL Inspection after launch.
technical.canonical: Self-referencing canonical on one https host (norasdr.com); 301 www and app-host variants; sitemap URLs identical to canonicals (canonical() in lib/site.ts already does this).
technical.robots: robots.ts: allow all public paths for Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot; disallow /app, /admin, /api, /book, /invite, /unsubscribe; one Sitemap: line. Check the Netlify/CDN layer does not block those bots. GPTBot, ClaudeBot and CCBot are a policy choice, not a ranking one.
technical.sitemap: sitemap.ts from PAGES + CONTENT + HUBS only; lastmod = hand-written `updated` as full ISO 8601 with time (Bing reads it for AI indexing); never the build time; no changefreq or priority reliance (Google ignores both). Add image:image entries for each featured image.
technical.feed: feed.xml (exists): every CONTENT page with canonical URL, summary, updated timestamp and enclosure for the featured image; <link rel=alternate type=application/rss+xml> in the marketing <head>.
technical.indexnow: Host /<key>.txt at the root; on publish or update, POST the changed URLs to api.indexnow.org from the deploy step. Reaches Bing, Yandex and others; Google does not use it.
technical.llms_txt: llms.txt (exists): keep it generated from CONTENT. Harmless, and not a ranking lever.
technical.structured_data: Home: Organization (logo 112px+, sameAs LinkedIn page, X, directory listings), WebSite (name Nora, alternateName Nora AI SDR), SoftwareApplication (offers price 0, no ratings until real visible reviews exist). Articles: BlogPosting with headline, image (16:9, 4:3, 1:1, each 1200px+), datePublished, dateModified, author. Every page: BreadcrumbList. Tools: WebApplication. Hubs: CollectionPage + ItemList. FAQPage markup is optional and earns no rich result since May 2026; visible FAQs stay because AI answers use them.
technical.authorship: The teammate byline (Sage, Scout, Quinn, Reese) names a part of the product, not a person, so schema author stays Organization. Do not mark teammates up as Person/ProfilePage. To meet Google's 'who wrote this' and AI-content fact-check guidance, add a real named human reviewer per article ('Reviewed by <name>, <role>' with a ProfilePage at /about/<name>) once the user supplies one. Do not invent one.
technical.images: One featured image per article at /images/<kind>/<slug>.webp (1600x900 hero, plus 1200x630 OG, 1200x900 and 1200x1200 crops for Article image). Hero is never lazy-loaded, has fetchpriority=high and explicit width/height. Alt text describes the picture without stuffing keywords. Add <meta name=robots content=max-image-preview:large>. Use one illustration style in Nora's tokens, with the owning teammate's colour as the accent. No text baked into images, no fake dashboards with invented numbers, no competitor logos.
technical.performance: CWV p75 targets: LCP <= 2.5s, INP <= 200ms, CLS <= 0.1. Fonts preloaded with font-display: swap; tools are small client leaf components; no third-party scripts on articles.
technical.on_page: One H1 per page (ArticleLayout renders it), then H2/H3 with no skipped levels; answer-first: a 1-2 sentence direct answer under every question-style H2; visible published and updated dates that match the schema; title <= 60 chars with the keyword first (brand first on the homepage only); unique meta description <= 155 chars.
technical.linking: Real <a href> links with descriptive anchors; pillar -> every spoke, spoke -> pillar + 2-4 siblings + one money page; homepage -> every pillar and hub; footer Resources column from CONTENT; no orphans (every page has 2+ inbound links in this plan).
technical.quality_gates: Every page passes the people-first self-assessment and adds something the top 3 lack (first-hand Nora rules and incidents, sourced dated tables). Every Nora number is imported from code (PUBLIC_LIMITS, INVITE_NOTE_MAX_CHARS), never retyped. Every claim about LinkedIn or a competitor is sourced and dated, and a person checks all AI-written text, titles, metas, schema and alt text before publishing. Never change a date without a real change.
technical.measurement: Verify Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools; submit the sitemap in both; watch the Bing AI Performance report for Copilot citations.
